## Castle Role visual style

- [ ] I followed [VISUAL_STYLE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/abolfazl2600/Castlegame/blob/main/VISUAL_STYLE_GUIDE.md), including silhouette, proportions, palette, detail density, and material reuse.
- [ ] I compared the new or revised asset with neighboring assets at normal gameplay zoom.
- [ ] I attached normal-zoom and close-up screenshots, plus a dense-scene view when repeated assets are involved.
- [ ] I checked 3D and 2D views where relevant, mobile/desktop layouts, save/load, and terrain/neighbor connections.
- [ ] I checked frame time and render calls for visual changes that add repeated geometry, animation, or effects.
- [ ] For a real historic template, I documented the reference period, plans/photos, and deviations from the source.

Mark items not applicable with a brief explanation. Gameplay-only changes can omit visual screenshots.
